# Thien Nguyen

> Lead Software Engineer, Software Architect & Agentic AI Architect. 10+ years designing resilient distributed systems, enterprise platforms, and developer tooling. Currently Lead Developer at CHECK24 Vergleichsportal GmbH (Munich), building AI-native SDLC tooling and multi-agent orchestration. Founder/creator of Agent Witch, the Guardz TypeScript ecosystem, and Wishees.

This site is a personal portfolio and resume. Machine-readable resume data is available at /resume.json (JSON Resume schema). A sitemap is at /sitemap.xml.

- [Resume](https://thiennp.github.io/resume.html): Full work history, education, and skills. Downloadable PDF at /Thien_Nguyen_Resume.pdf. Structured data also at /resume.json.
- [Projects](https://thiennp.github.io/index.html): Featured projects (Wishees, Guardz Ecosystem, Agent Witch, Structure Validation), all designed and built solo.
- [Agent Witch case study](https://thiennp.github.io/agent-witch-case-study.html): Architecture deep-dive on Agent Witch's Cloud Control Plane, WebSocket security model, and durable workflow state machine.
- [Contact](https://thiennp.github.io/contact.html): Email, LinkedIn, Medium, GitHub, and Stack Overflow.
